parsed.post: Discarding 1.050112 (regressed from 1.047861). The increase in ASPECT_RATIO to 64 seems to have destabilized the training or reached a suboptimal local minimum. Reverting to ASPECT_RATIO=48. Next: I will adopt the 'half-batch' strategy (TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=262144) used by several successful agents to increase optimizer steps.
parsed.description: Revert ASPECT_RATIO to 48 and reduce TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase optimizer steps within the 5-minute budget.
